title: Data Type Declaration
prompt:
Write a program that declares and initializes variables of different data types, including integers, floats, and strings. The program should then print out the values and data types of these variables.
Sample Input: None
Sample Output: Variable a is of type int and has value 10
Variable b is of type float and has value 3.14
Variable c is of type str and has value Hello, World!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that meets your requirements:

```python
# Declare and initialize variables of different data types
a = 10  # int
b = 3.14  # float
c = "Hello, World!"  # str

# Print out the values and data types of the variables
print(f"Variable a is of type int and has value {a}")
print(f"Variable b is of type float and has value {b}")
print(f"Variable c is of type str and has value '{c}'")
```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
Variable a is of type int and has value 10
Variable b is of type float and has value 3.14
Variable c is of type str and has value 'Hello, World!'
```
